output.scope: Deterministic, zero-dependency coverage of the latest documented (2025–2026) prompt-injection concealment and exfiltration TTPs. Built to pair with an ML classifier.
output.out_of_scope: Reworded/semantic attacks, payloads split across multiple messages or files, and binary inputs (images, audio, PDFs).

ttps.name: Unicode TAG smuggling (U+E0000–E007F)
ttps.default_severity: high (critical if the payload is agent-directed)
ttps.tools: reveal decodes to ASCII; scan flags any TAG char outside a valid emoji tag sequence (emoji base + tag spec + CANCEL TAG)
ttps.citation: arXiv:2504.11168 (Hackett et al., Bypassing LLM Guardrails: character injection incl. Unicode tags/zero-width/homoglyphs)

ttps.name: Zero-width character injection / ZW binary encoding
ttps.default_severity: high when inside words above density threshold or a run of 8+; low for stray chars; emoji ZWJ and Arabic/Persian/Indic joiners exempt
ttps.tools: reveal strips; scan measures intra-word density
ttps.citation: arXiv:2504.11168 (Hackett et al., Bypassing LLM Guardrails: character injection incl. Unicode tags/zero-width/homoglyphs)

ttps.name: Bidi override / embedding (Trojan-Source style)
ttps.default_severity: high for LRO/RLO/LRE/RLE/PDF; low for RLM/LRM/isolates in RTL text; medium without RTL text
ttps.tools: scan
ttps.citation: arXiv:2504.11168 (Hackett et al., Bypassing LLM Guardrails: character injection incl. Unicode tags/zero-width/homoglyphs)

ttps.name: Homoglyph: mixed scripts within one word; NFKC compat chars
ttps.tools: scan flags words mixing scripts (CJK scripts grouped); single-script non-Latin words are clean; egress_check flags IDN hosts
ttps.citation: arXiv:2504.11168 (Hackett et al., Bypassing LLM Guardrails: character injection incl. Unicode tags/zero-width/homoglyphs)

ttps.name: Encoded payloads (base64/hex/rot13/url/entities, depth ≤2)
ttps.default_severity: high when decoded text is agent-directed or has role tokens
ttps.tools: reveal bounded decode of encoded spans; data:image base64 exempt
ttps.citation: arXiv:2504.11168 (Hackett et al., Bypassing LLM Guardrails: character injection incl. Unicode tags/zero-width/homoglyphs)

ttps.name: Chat-template / role-token smuggling

ttps.name: Injection phrase in hidden HTML (phrase list, extra signal)

ttps.tools: reveal visible/hidden split; scan

ttps.name: KEY SIGNAL: text present ONLY in a hidden or decoded view
ttps.default_severity: medium/review for substantive concealed text; critical/suspicious when agent-directed; descriptive alt/title/aria/meta and dev comments clean
ttps.tools: scan compares each hidden/decoded view with the visible text; agent-directed = imperative + AI addressee / 'the user' / URL-email target, or second-person directive in concealed text
ttps.citation: arXiv:2302.12173 (Greshake et al., Indirect Prompt Injection)

ttps.name: Decode-and-follow wrapper
